clauses.title: 1. LEASE TERM AND COMMENCEMENT
clauses.text: 1. LEASE TERM AND COMMENCEMENT. Lessor leases to Lessee the industrial machinery listed in Exhibit A for an initial term of thirty-six (36) months commencing October 1, 2026.

clauses.title: 2. MONTHLY RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT
clauses.text: 2. MONTHLY RENT AND SECURITY DEPOSIT. Lessee shall remit monthly rent of $5,400.00 on the first business day of each month, along with an upfront security deposit of $10,800.00.

clauses.title: 3. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR COVENANTS
clauses.text: 3. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIR COVENANTS. Lessee assumes sole responsibility for all routine maintenance, preventative servicing, and repairs required to maintain the machinery in certified operating condition.

clauses.title: 4. MANDATORY INSURANCE COVERAGE
clauses.text: 4. MANDATORY INSURANCE COVERAGE. Lessee shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than $2,000,000.00 per occurrence naming Lessor as an additional insured party.

clauses.title: 5. LESSOR INSPECTION RIGHTS
clauses.text: 5. LESSOR INSPECTION RIGHTS. Lessor and its authorized agents may enter Lessee's premises during standard operating hours upon forty-eight (48) hours advance written notice to inspect the leased equipment.

clauses.title: 6. UNRESTRICTED DEFAULT AND REPOSSESSION
clauses.text: 6. UNRESTRICTED DEFAULT AND REPOSSESSION. Upon Lessee's failure to pay rent within ten (10) days of the due date, Lessor may repossess the equipment immediately without judicial process.

clauses.title: 7. PROHIBITION OF ASSIGNMENT OR SUBLEASE
clauses.text: 7. PROHIBITION OF ASSIGNMENT OR SUBLEASE. Lessee shall not assign, sublease, or pledge the equipment without Lessor's prior written consent, which Lessor may withhold at its sole discretion.
